handling: Bedford (independent) city was added back to Bedford County effective July 1, 2013. For the 2008 and 2012 waves (2006-2010 and 2008-2012 ACS vintages) source data may still carry 51515; it is recoded to 51019 and combined so every wave has a single Bedford County, VA row (51019).

Shannon County, SD (46113) was renamed Oglala Lakota County and assigned FIPS 46102 effective May 1, 2015. The 2006-2010 and 2008-2012 ACS/CVAP vintages and RUCC 2003/2013 use 46113; recoded to 46102 so the county is comparable across waves.

Wade Hampton Census Area, AK (02270) was renamed Kusilvak Census Area and assigned FIPS 02158 effective July 1, 2015. Recoded to 02158. Note: Alaska has no county-level presidential returns in MEDSL (see build notes), so this affects covariates only.

Valdez-Cordova Census Area, AK (02261) was split into Chugach Census Area (02063) and Copper River Census Area (02066) effective January 2, 2019. Pre-2019 vintages (2008/2012/2016 waves) carry 02261; 2020 and 2024 waves carry the two successor areas. Left as native geography per wave (documented, not reconciled). Affects covariates only (no AK county-level returns).
Second successor area of the 2019 Valdez-Cordova split. See the 02063 row.

Effective for 2022-vintage products, Connecticut's 8 counties were replaced by 9 COG-based planning regions as county-equivalents (FIPS 09110-09190). Planning-region boundaries do NOT nest within old county boundaries. Per the build decision, geography is kept native per wave: 2008-2020 waves use the 8 legacy counties (09001-09015), the 2024 wave uses the 9 planning regions. CT is therefore not a consistent 5-wave panel; RUCC 2023 (still on legacy counties) does not join to the 2024 CT rows, which get NA ruralurban_cc / rural_pct with a documented note.
See the 09001 -> 09190 row; listed per successor unit for completeness.
